fc_app_angular.rationale: Angular CLI requires Ivy partial-compile output (ɵcmp). Compiling @fc/ui-system via raw tsc emits __decorate which Angular rejects ('imports must be standalone'). Wiring TS paths makes the app's ngc compile fc-ui-system sources directly with Ivy.

Visual browser proof deferred to F6 (requires Playwright/headed browser); HTTP wire path proven end-to-end.

grep_proof.hardcoded_urls_in_app_src: ZERO (only '/config.json' bootstrap fetch — not a product URL; runtime endpoints come from FcRuntimeConfig)

doctrine_alignment.single_source_runtime: Angular shell receives all surfaces/nav/zones/chrome/shortcuts/banners/policies from /api/ui-os/workspace-runtime via FC_RUNTIME_CONFIG.endpoints.workspaceRuntime — no SPA-side normalization, no fallback shell payload.
doctrine_alignment.empty_db_renders_empty_ui: Confirmed: empty DB rows → ui-os emits empty arrays/objects → shell shows visible 'no nav' / 'no header surfaces' / 'no main surfaces' diagnostics — no Home/Foundation invented.
doctrine_alignment.fc_runtime_config_single_source: FC_RUNTIME_CONFIG token now lives only in @fc/ui-system. App imports it (no duplicate token), provides value from /config.json (no build-time bake).
doctrine_alignment.no_oidc_yet: Token forwarding via cookie credentials only ('credentials: include'); auth wiring deferred per scope.
doctrine_alignment.no_domain_components: <fc-workspace-shell-v2 /> is the entire app surface; no Foundation/Console pages mounted.
doctrine_alignment.router_state: provideRouter([]) — required for Angular bootstrap but no route paths declared.
